zh: 修复插入后从 Dock 重开时文档公式列表为空的问题；插入过程中可切换已有公式，并保护未保存的草稿。修复双击公式打开编辑器却没有置前的问题，保存后返回 Word。将取消和提交按钮放到编辑模式栏右侧，节省编辑空间。
en: Restore the document equation list when reopening from the Dock after insertion. Existing equations can be selected during insertion, with a prompt protecting changed drafts. Fix the editor opening behind Word on double-click and return focus to Word after saving. Move Cancel and the submit action to the right of the editing mode controls.
